title: The Logger Takes the Seat
prompt: If Troy Jackson wins: does Maine get the thing it asked for, or a vote?
framing: A fifth-generation logger from Allagash, substituted onto the ballot in July, beats the only Republican who has ever held a Trump-losing state three times over. The polls had him +3 to +4 in October with the over-50s against him.

z.pos: The seat answers to Maine — rent, insulin, the shipyard
z.neg: The seat answers to a caucus; nothing changes in Maine

split.seam: C + A realized, B frustrated, D split — the populist right can't decide whether losing Collins was a loss
split.rationale: The seat flipping realizes the left on both rings and frustrates the institutional right absolutely; the populist right's z sits near zero because Collins was never theirs.

A.source: race reading — authored z-first, blind to the other variant

fluid.text: Maine sent a Democrat. The map got one seat closer and that is the whole story tonight.
fluid.zReason: The seat is realized as a count, not as Maine's object; the caucus delivers, not the county.

coalition.text: A logger from Allagash beat Collins on cost of living. We will hold him to the drug-pricing votes, and we will have the votes to hold.
coalition.zReason: Delivery runs through the majority he makes possible; trusted because the holder is the caucus.

denominated.text: I don't need him to be one of ours. Fifty-one is fifty-one, and the committee gavels are the object.
denominated.zReason: The gavel is a real instrument and the seat produces it; the rim trusts the caucus completely.

B.source: race reading — authored z-first, blind to the other variant

fluid.text: We lost the one Republican who could win Maine. That's it. That's the seat.
fluid.zReason: The object was the majority's margin and it walked out; nothing replaces it.

instrument.holder: Senator Collins' record and the Appropriations gavel

coalition.text: She voted for the housing ban, against the rescissions, alone on the ACA rule — and lost anyway. Tell me what the record was for.
coalition.zReason: The record is trusted and useless; the instrument delivered to Maine and Maine didn't return it.

instrument.holder: Senator Collins' record and the Appropriations gavel

denominated.text: Thirty years of appropriations for Maine walk out the door, and Bath will learn what a freshman in the minority can bring home.
denominated.zReason: The rim's object is the Appropriations gavel; it is gone outright.

instrument.holder: Senator Collins' record and the Appropriations gavel

C.source: race reading — authored z-first, blind to the other variant

fluid.text: A logger in the Senate. Finally somebody who has stood on a blockade.
fluid.zReason: The seat is the object and it is held by one of us; realized on sight.

coalition.text: He didn't win on her record, he won on rent and insulin. Now the caucus has to move on both or he is just another vote.
coalition.zReason: Realized at the seat, conditional on the caucus — the holder is trusted, the caucus less so.

denominated.text: If Jackson votes for the next CR with the war money in it, I will say so out loud. The seat isn't the object; who it answers to is.
denominated.zReason: The rim trusts Jackson and distrusts the vehicle; z stays positive but thin.

D.source: race reading — authored z-first, blind to the other variant

fluid.text: Collins lost because she was never with us. Good riddance, bad trade.
fluid.zReason: A loss on paper, but not of anything the station held.

instrument.holder: the next vehicle on the floor

coalition.text: A union logger beat a Trump-skeptic Republican in a state Trump lost three times. That's the establishment's loss, not ours.
coalition.zReason: The frustrated object belongs to B; D's own object was never in the seat.

instrument.holder: the next vehicle on the floor

denominated.text: Jackson is a Democrat who talks like us. Watch the tariff vote — if he breaks with Schumer, Maine got a better deal than we did.
denominated.zReason: The rim half-trusts the holder as a populist; z crosses zero on the chance of a defection.

instrument.holder: the next vehicle on the floor

window.rule: §4c — the trigger day is declared in advance; the frame dates itself on the vote

meta.source: Parallelogram race reading, 2026-10-12 — two conditional Readings per seat; one collapses into the live Reading on 11-03, the other retires as the record of the miss
